description: Client-side script for BOM Comparison Tool page in ERPNext, handling UI interactions, data fetching, and rendering BOM differences.

classes.name: BOMComparisonTool
classes.description: Class managing BOM comparison UI, data fetching, and rendering logic.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the BOMComparisonTool with the page object.

methods.name: make_form
methods.description: Creates the form UI with BOM selection fields and preview area.

methods.name: fetch_and_render
methods.description: Fetches BOM differences and triggers rendering.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders BOM differences including changed values, row changes, and added/removed rows.

methods.name: get_changed_values
methods.description: Filters and returns changed, visible, non-hidden field values.
